footer_news_desc: Subscribe to follow our impact in La Gônave.
about_text: Because every community deserves a brighter future, GED is committed every day in La Gonâve. Discover how our initiatives are changing the lives of hundreds of families.
about_pillar1_text: We encourage local production to ensure food security for Gonâve families.
about_pillar2_text: We work with schools to support children and parents who lack resources.
about_pillar3_text: We preserve our cultural heritage while providing humanitarian aid to the most vulnerable.
stats_children: Children mentored for a bright future.
stats_trees: Trees planted to protect our land.
services_desc: Every GED project is a seed of hope planted thanks to the generosity of our donors.
services_item1_text: Thanks to donations, we provide a daily hot meal to schoolchildren, turning hunger into energy for success.
services_item2_text: Through this program, GED provides essential psychological support, helping community members overcome trauma and regain lasting emotional balance.
services_item3_text: Investing in our farmers means securing La Gonâve's self-sufficiency. GED provides the tools and seeds needed to feed future generations.
services_item4_text: Providing a space for reflection and listening to guide our youth. GED supports young people in their guidance to help them make informed choices about their future.
action_subtitle_text: There are many ways to help us transform the future of La Gonâve.

tourism_subtitle: The excellence of craftsmanship and the splendor of tourism, driven by our community commitment.
tourism_item1_title: Between Land and Sea: The Brilliance of La Gonâve
tourism_item1_desc: This spectacular aerial view captures the very essence of La Gonâve island. Between its lush green mountains, its growing urban development, and its turquoise waters lined with mangroves, this image reflects the immense potential and preserved natural beauty of our territory. A true crossroads of life and hope for the future.
tourism_item2_desc: Crochet is a vibrant tradition in the hands of our artisan women. This red hat shows how a simple thread can become a high-class accessory, blending modernity with local culture.
tourism_item3_desc: Dive into the unexplored with this majestic cave where light dances on crystal-clear water. This natural sanctuary offers an experience of absolute serenity, a reminder that La Gonâve is full of hidden treasures waiting to be protected and admired by lovers of nature and adventure.
tourism_item4_desc: This masterful bas-relief captures the very essence of our identity, turning wood into a living story of our traditions. Every chisel stroke tells of our farmers' courage and the timeless beauty of the landscapes that make our land proud.
tourism_item5_desc: La Gonâve reveals its finest assets with this crystal lagoon. A preserved environment where the water's clarity reflects the richness and purity of our ecological heritage.
tourism_item6_desc: Every stitch of these garments is proof of the immense talent of our creators. It's a blend of creativity and high quality, where colors and shapes come together to showcase local handmade production.
tourism_footer_text: Every action counts for our island's sovereignty.
edu_subtitle: Educating youth and cultivating the future: two essential pillars for a sovereign and prosperous Gonâve.
edu_item1_title: The Visionary School of Nan Café
edu_item1_desc: Founded in 1997, this pioneering institution has educated generations of Gonâve children.
edu_item2_desc: Since 2006, GED has led reforestation campaigns that restore our watersheds.
edu_item3_desc: Integrating trees into farming systems to improve yields.
edu_item4_desc: Sewing, carpentry, computer skills, and management to empower young people.
edu_item5_desc: Thousands of seedlings produced each season for food security.
edu_item6_desc: We proudly honor the island's top students with excellence awards. A heartfelt gesture to reward their efforts and inspire an entire generation.
edu_item7_desc: Training farmers in organic farming techniques.
edu_item8_desc: Microcredit and technical support for farmers.
edu_item9_desc: Gonave Espoir de Demain supports these many children focused on their notebooks. Every word written is one more step toward the island's development.
edu_footer_text: Education and agriculture are the pillars of our sovereignty.
donation_card_text: Thanks to generous donations covering our operating costs, 100% of your donation directly funds our projects in La Gonâve.
